gen-gf-baumans-gf-im-fell-english-sc: IM Fell English SC has a bookish, editorial feel, with a modest taper like a sharpened pencil line. IM Fell English SC and Baumans make an odd, memorable couple: tube-like uniform strokes against a serif that still breathes.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-inria-serif: Baumans draws every letter as a single track width, like neon tubing, while Inria Serif brings dignified, wide-mouthed curves below. Text runs smoothly, with a refined feel.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-joan: Commanding strokes of uniform thickness up top, with no thin parts to vanish. And Joan, a text serif with the soft thick-thin shift of a lightly pressed brush, gives the pair its most appealing quality: a strong head over a gentle, classic voice.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-junge: Baumans draws with the steady line of a technical pen. Junge answers underneath with moderate stroke variation and generous gaps in its curves, so the heading feels engineered and the text feels authoritative and settled.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-kameron: Wrench-wide c's, one thickness throughout. Baumans is built that way, and Kameron, a serif with mild stroke contrast and curves that refuse to close, would feel much more bookish than the heading if the heading were made small.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-libertinus-serif: That crescent-wrench c, drawn rope-thin with no thick or thin parts, is what makes Baumans stand out. Libertinus Serif handles the body, so give its size the attention.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-libre-caslon-text: That crescent-wrench c, drawn with pencil-line consistency, is the signature of Baumans. But Libre Caslon Text brings low-key thick-thin variation and curves left unfinished, so it handles reading while the heading handles attention.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-lustria: Baumans rings every o with a constant wall. Lustria, a serif with sensible thick-thin shifts and a wide mouth on its lowercase a, adds a traditional, authoritative weight, and the two hold together by contrast.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-maitree: Dignified, a little classic. Maitree, a text serif, swells from hairline to stem and opens its curves, so a long passage reads with a measured ease beneath Baumans's tubular, wire-like heading.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-marcellus: Baumans sets down its signage-like letters at one plain line weight, with a wrench-wide c that is hard to forget. Marcellus follows with hairline-free thin strokes and a refined, literary tone.
